details:
Cosmic Remnants is an interactive digital museum designed to preserve and share the stories of four NASA mission artifacts left on the Moon and Mars. The website presents real images and accessible explanations of the Apollo Lunar Module Descent Stage, Lunar Roving Vehicle, Apollo Lunar Surface Experiments Package (ALSEP), and Mars Pathfinder Sojourner Rover.

Visitors can explore each artifact, learn about its original purpose and scientific contribution, and discover why it remained on another world after its mission. The project was developed as a multilingual website using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with interactive learning activities, a child-friendly section, and accessibility features.

We chose this approach because space history should be accessible to everyone, including young learners and people with different accessibility needs. Cosmic Remnants turns mission hardware into a way to understand human curiosity, scientific progress, and the future of exploration.
